game.title: Horizon Forbidden West
game.blurb: Open-world action RPG from Guerrilla Games, released 2022-02-18. RAWG has no playtime yet. Genres: Action, Adventure, RPG. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes.

chapters.title: The Main Story
chapters.summary: Aloy's journey west, from the Daunt to the end of the main quest. Spoiler-guarded.

chapters.title: Open World Activities
chapters.summary: Tallnecks, Cauldrons, rebel camps and outposts, Relic Ruins, Hunting Grounds, the Arena, Machine Strike and side quests.

chapters.title: Machines and Combat
chapters.summary: Killing and scanning every machine type, overrides, stealth, melee combos and heavy weapons.

chapters.title: Gear, Skills and Levels
chapters.summary: Player levels, skill trees, Valor Surges, weapon and outfit upgrades, coils and pouches.

chapters.title: Burning Shores (DLC)
chapters.summary: The Burning Shores expansion: its story, new machines, skills and activities.

chapters.title: New Game+ and Ultra Hard
chapters.summary: A second run, Ultra Hard difficulty and the New Game+ rewards.

notes: Backlog game, picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year (docs/PLAN.md section 2 ordering). StrategyWiki has a stub page (completion stage 0); Walkthrough and Achievements subpages are linked but not written. horizon.fandom.com answers the API, with about 114 linked pages; names only were looked at, nothing copied. The Steam app is the Complete Edition (2420110), which includes the Burning Shores expansion. 48 of 80 Steam achievements are hidden, but their names are plain, so most were sorted by name: story beats to the main story, activities to open world, and the Burning Shores block (at the end of the schema) to its own chapter. "Defeated Asera" and "Defeated the Enduring" were put in open world from their names; check them.
